insights.one_liner: KNAW is the Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences, voice of Dutch science with its own research institutes; a recognised visa sponsor, and its Utrecht research job shows pay.

culture.text: KNAW calls itself the forum, voice and conscience of science in the Netherlands, with institutes whose research and collections rank among the international top.
A government-linked research body; staff often come from UvA, Leiden, Utrecht and VU, in fields like history, economics, physics and medicine.
Its one open job here is an entry-level research role in Utrecht that states the pay.

open.text: KNAW is an IND recognised sponsor.
Its current job here does not require Dutch.

growth.text: The KNAW Van Walree Fund awarded grants to five projects in 2026.

worth_knowing.text: At the installation of new members, KNAW warned that academic freedom is increasingly being questioned.
KNAW has a new chair who previously served on the board of the UvA.
